test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.**

She was upset seeing the __scattered__ documents.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gathered**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Scattered **means to be dispersed or spread out. (फैलाया जाना)

 
 
• **For example- ***The books were scattered all around the room.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Gathered **means to bring together or collect. (एक साथ लाना या एकत्र करना)
 
 
• **For example- ***I went to several libraries to gather information about the plans.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the person was upset seeing the scattered documents, which means that the documents were not organized and were all over the place.
 
• Therefore, the opposite of scattered would be if the documents were gathered in one place.

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Perished **means to die or come to an end. (मरना या ख़त्म होना)
 
• **Dissipated **means to disappear or disperse. (गायब या बिखर जाना)
 
• **Sprinkled **means to scatter in small amounts. (थोड़ी मात्रा में बिखेरना)
